definitions.supported: Native arena action or presentation can be requested. This does not mean an authored moving drawing exists.
definitions.motionSupported: The exact action has admitted drawn poses or native mesh motion.
definitions.drawn: A measured and admitted atlas/strip supplies distinct drawn poses for this action.
definitions.mesh: The exact native source plate has an admitted measured mesh pose for this action.
definitions.static: The exact native plate remains the visible fallback; physics and effects may still move it.

limitations: Admission does not prove browser image loading or a gameplay receipt; the renderer keeps its own guards and native fallback.
A presentation rig does not imply drawn locomotion, combat, special attacks or full prone animation.
This ten-action view excludes conditional paired capture and exit choreography, which remain independently admitted by their existing registries.
Light and heavy may deliberately share the same three anatomically adapted keyposes; repeated uses are counted once per media path and frame.
All source-franchise references remain project adaptations, with no certified frame-for-frame or 1:1 fidelity.
Legacy V179 profile fields remain historical; the current UI reads this V189 view instead.

fixtures.description: Tests prepare idle, movement, attack, guard, recoil, KO and airborne sampler inputs. These fixtures validate source/action selection and never count as played matches.

sourceState: V189 working tree before commit; derived from admitted registries on disk.
